message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. Centered and dominating the upper half is the word "TEMPO" in large, gray capital letters. Above it, two columns of smaller black text read "INVESTIGASI: REKENING BOCOR AIR JAKARTA" and "GITARIS SLANK TENTANG KONSER DUA JARI." To the right, below the title, is the date "14-20 JULI 2014."

A smiling man wearing a black suit, white shirt, red tie, and a black peci cap is being lifted by a crowd. He holds both hands up, forming "V" signs with his fingers. Numerous arms and hands of people below reach upward, supporting his body. These arms are clad in various sleeves, including plaid patterns and dark solid colors. At the bottom, the word "JOKOWI!" is written in large, bold, white capital letters across the lower torso and arms of the crowd.

A red vertical stripe borders the left edge. In the bottom-left corner, there is a barcode and text reading "RP 35.000." The composition uses a clean, white background behind the central figure and the magazine's title.
